_rules: No generated human faces presented as real people: no client testimonial portraits, no team photos. That is a false-advertising problem and it is visible to visitors.
Generated images are for decorative heroes, textures, abstract illustrations, section backgrounds and pictograms.
Real photos or licensed stock for anything that claims to depict this business, its staff or its customers.
Every entry needs an id, a prompt written for this brief, and a size. The agent fills this file once; the script does the calling.

defaults.style: Describe the shared art direction here so every asset belongs to the same family: medium, lighting, palette, grain, level of abstraction.

images.prompt: Replace with a prompt specific to this brief's subject matter. Name the medium, the lighting, the composition and what must NOT be in frame.
Second asset, same family, different framing.
